description: Readback of distinct published experiments plus the newly recovered frozen CTRL diagnostic. These experiments are not pooled into the common candidate's acceptance evidence.

MEM.latest_scope: MEM6, separately declared disjoint source groups; historical exposure and sealed independent confirmation not authenticated
MEM.next_required: Independent new-source confirmation and production original memory-writer bridge; keep retention effect separate from selector effect.

CTRL.next_required: Original owner-bound information-acquisition action and reachable successor-state evidence; C is historical availability, not a causal READ effect.

PERC.next_required: Independent real-source tasks and production acquisition/Cell ownership integration; rules remain the stronger observed baseline.

ACT.next_required: Production CellStateOwner/FinalUse integration and independent selection/recovery/repair task benefit; repeated seeds and controlled probes do not increase task n.

VERIFY.next_required: Independent real-task roster, authenticated allocation, original terminal labels and complete repair/cost lineage.

PRED.historical_189_fits: Development execution count; original artifacts not located in the cited follow-up.
PRED.next_required: Locate original task/action owner and independent effect observer; prove one-step prediction changes real decisions before extending rollout horizon.

stages.P0: OPEN: one integrated implementation exists; the complete original StageOwner assembly and ordinary Adopt/NoUpdate A-learning-independent-B-C-cold-recovery runs are not established.
stages.P1: OPEN: fixed-topology component evidence remains below the independent net-benefit adoption gate.
stages.P2: HOLD: compare credit, clocks, replay and kernels only after task benefit and complete cost accounting.
stages.P3: HOLD: topology changes require explicit interaction hypotheses, state migration, recovery, cost and old-task retention.
stages.P4: HOLD: frozen/current/generated learner controls and unchanged-experience reference require independent task families, windows, initial conditions and full learner-generation cost.

statistical_policy: Keep source groups, actual tasks, repeats, training seeds, optimizer fits and engineering tests separate.
Choose sample size from the real independent unit, target effect and a prespecified power design; do not infer power from raw episode counts.
Record training, search, failed work, validation, recovery and communication costs; unmeasured categories remain unknown.
Do not use a signature, checksum, native component pass or archive restoration as proof of independent task custody or whole-run adoption.
